liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mission In The Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it a killer tune and their favorite of five; Reviewer loved the song and played the show specifically for it [11][12]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Samson was pretty much brand new at the time of this show [19]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): This version is a hit, setting a high benchmark [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-12.132933.mtx.nicksmix.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1976-06-12.143169.fm.warburton.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: FM broadcast; 24 songs; 188 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1976-06-12.fm.sbd.moore.berger.100328.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 177 min; rated 4.86/5 by 7 [6]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is better than archive, though some noise remains; Nice sound and recording quality noted by the listener [10][12]
- **gd1976-06-12.110456.akg.warburton.berger.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [7]. Said about its sound: Version is smoother than the CM version, which is too bright; Great sound quality noted, though no visuals are available [13][17]

## Around the show

- Jerry played a Travis Bean guitar, reportedly for Billy's birthday [9]
- Bobby announced it was Bill Kreutzmann's birthday after Samson and Delilah [15]
- Brief cut during Mission In The Rain on FM source [1]
- Sounds different than '74; Jer played Travis Bean through Mesa-Boogie [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-12.132933.mtx.nicksmix.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Nick Crump; source: Matrix Mix of Shnid 100328 (FM) and Shnid 110456 (AUD) [1]
- **gd1976-06-12.143169.fm.warburton.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jimmy Warburton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: FM Broadcast; Master Reel to Reel > Jim Warburton's 1st generation 7" reels @ 3 3/4 ips [2]
- **gd1976-06-12.fm.sbd.moore.berger.100328.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: WBCN simulcast FM > Master Reel (Sony TC-755 reel/Teac AN-180 dolby unit Maxell UD 35-180 tape) [6]. Also: Tape sourced from WBRU radio feed, originally from WBCN [9]
- **gd1976-06-12.110456.akg.warburton.berger.flac16**: transferred by Rob Berger; source: aud 1st gen reel, akg d1000e's>sony tc-152, taped by Jimmy Warburton, transfer by Rob Berger [7]
